full_judgment: 15. In view of the above we hold that the appointing authority ought to have disclosed to the plaintiff the nature of adverse confidential antecedents against him and given him an opportunity to explain his conduct. As the appointing authority did not do so the impugned order of termination of service must be held to have been passed illegally. We set aside the decree passed by the trial Court and upheld by the appellate Court. We decree the suit and declare that the impugned order of termination is illegal and the plaintiff is still in service.
